consent_body: To understand how people use Rusuh — the pages they open and the steps of a purchase. No personal data, no ads. The queue and purchases work either way.
consent_body_short: No personal data. Your place is safe either way.
consent_settings_intro: This choice is for this device only. Change it any time.
consent_required_body: What makes Rusuh work: your sign-in, your queue number, your language. Never used for analytics.
consent_analytics_body: Google Analytics: the pages opened and the steps of a purchase, to improve Rusuh. No name, email, NIK or ads.
consent_errors_note: Error reports are sent without cookies or personal data, so we can fix problems quickly.
account_privacy_hint: Pages opened and purchase steps, no personal data. This device only.
